changelog:
Initial release of fetch-zhihu-content:

- Enables downloading any Zhihu article or answer by URL and saves content as Markdown.
- Supports both zhuanlan.zhihu.com articles, zhihu.com answer/question pages, and multiple URLs at once.
- Automatically selects and extracts clean text using Playwright in a real browser window.
- Output includes Markdown files with titles and metadata; optional browser/platform switching.
- Handles dynamic page loading and supports headless mode on non-GUI systems.
